card.name: Linking words in lab-study descriptions
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as by, from, of, the, and words like vitro or enzyme, inside phrases that introduce how a finding was obtained, such as in vitro or clinical studies. It appears in drug interaction and enzyme study text.

modes.label: Method linking words
modes.description: A short word like by, from or of that links a result to its method or source.
modes.example: The location of a metal-binding site on the enzyme was determined<< by>> x-ray diffraction of Cet1
